sermons.title: Sermon 625 | Jesus Appearing To Mary Magdalene

scripture.verse: Now when Jesus was risen early the first day of the week, He appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom He had cast seven devils.
He that waters shall be watered also himself.
Whom He justified, them He also glorified.

Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the Church, and gave Himself for her, that He might sanctify and cleanse her with the washing of water by the Word, that He might present her to Himself a glorious Church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without blemish.

And the Lord said unto Joshua, See, I ha ve given into your hands Jericho and the king thereof and the mighty men of valor. And you shall compass the city, all you men of war and go round about the city once. Thus shall you do six days.

sermons.title: Sermon 630 | The Holy Spirit Compared To The Wind

scripture.verse: The wind blows where it wishes and you hear the sound of it, but cannot tell from where it comes and where it goes. So is everyone that is born of the Spirit.

What king, going to make war against another king, sits not down first and consults whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him that comes against him with twenty thousand? Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends a delegation and desires conditions of peace.
Come and see. ... Come and dine.

sermons.title: Sermon 634 | Christians Kept In Time And Glorified In Eternity

scripture.verse: Now unto Him that is able to keep you from falling and to present you faultless before the presence of His glory with exceeding joy, to the only wise God our Savor, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
